item.title: Carroll County Bridge Deck Replacement Complete
item.description: The Route JJ Bridge in Carroll County is now open. item.title: Jail Booking For Livingston County
item.description: Another booking at the Caldwell County Detention Center for Livingston County was reported by the Sheriff’s Department. On Wednesday, Chillicothe Police officers arrested 19-year-old Jayce Bryson Gatson. He was booked on a 24-hour hold with no bond allowed, pending the filing of charges.

item.title: 2026/27 Chillicothe R-II School District Calendar Approved
item.description: The Chillicothe R-II School District will begin the school year in 2026 on August 25th. The school year will end on May 21st, with Senior Graduation on May 16th. item.title: Declaration Of Surplus Approved By School Board
item.description: The declaration of surplus items was approved by the Chillicothe R-II School Board. Superintendent Dr Dan Wiebers says the list includes some kitchen equipment. Some desks and library items. The date of the auction was not discussed.

item.title: New Filing For Ambulance Board
item.description: Another name has been added to the ballot for the April Municipal Election. Megan Hall has filed for the Livingston County Ambulance Board. Filing for the April Municipal Election continues through 5:00 pm on December 30th.
